local_reimplementations.name: CollectionTable
local_reimplementations.notes: narduk-libs ships no table component at all; this is the app's own hardened, tested, documented table primitive (see patterns.table).

local_reimplementations.name: StatePanel
local_reimplementations.notes: variant: empty|blocked|clear|absent, each with distinct copy semantics (empty vs 'unknown is not zero'). Plausible AppEmptyState overlap by name/purpose only -- prop-level comparison against narduk-core's AppEmptyState not performed (out of L6 scope, see L0).

local_reimplementations.name: FreshnessStamp
local_reimplementations.notes: small figure-bearing freshness/staleness stamp; issue #253 proposes a pattern-gate rule specifically for this class of module. Plausible NsFreshnessChip overlap by name/purpose only -- not verified against narduk-ui's implementation.

local_reimplementations.name: FilterBar
local_reimplementations.notes: renders filter chips/facets; explicitly does NOT own the search query field or refresh/close controls per its own doc comment (those are separate, uninventoried .op-search markup in callers). narduk-libs ships no filter/search-bar component.

local_reimplementations.name: status chip family (DomainChip, clients/KindChip, products/AnalyticsChip, products/Badges)
local_reimplementations.notes: four separate small badge/chip components, one per domain area, no shared generic status-badge primitive; narduk-libs ships no status badge component either. Only DomainChip's own LOC/consumers measured; the other three not individually sized (out of budget).

table.server_api: none (app is read-model-driven: server/api/read-model.get.ts, products.get.ts, analytics.get.ts, live.get.ts carry no page/limit/cursor/sort query params -- tables render a full pre-aggregated snapshot client-side)
table.notes: This is the ONLY table surface in the app today -- all ~11 raw <table> usages the lane brief anticipated have already been consolidated onto this ONE shared local component via PRs #155, #159, #186, #269, #276 (see defect_history). Sort/pagination/search are NOT built in: projects/index.vue does its own client-side [...].sort() (line 49); no page does pagination (page_size not applicable -- reads full read-model snapshot); FilterBar is a separate, partial (chips-only) component. mobile='cards' is an approximation: the component's own doc comment describes it as 'the SAME real table, same DOM order, one cell per line, headers dropped' below 1000px -- NOT a redesigned card, and horizontal-scroll/hidden-columns are explicitly prohibited in its header comment (verified: no overflow-x in the file). column_count=5 and column_types are from one sample (app/pages/products/index.vue productColumns, line 283) -- other consumers' column defs not individually counted (17 consumers, out of budget to enumerate each).

sort_control.notes: inline `[...projects.value].sort(...)` at line 49, client-side only, not a shared control; open issue #330 'Products render in YAML file order, not sorted alphabetically' and #201 'sort observed timestamps chronologically' show this need recurring unaddressed elsewhere.

filter_search_bar.notes: chip/facet rendering only; query input (.op-search) is separate uninventoried markup per caller.

status_chip_badge.notes: one of four domain-specific chip components (KindChip, AnalyticsChip, Badges also exist); no shared generic badge.

freshness_indicator.notes: figure-bearing freshness stamp; issue #253 tracks a pattern-gate rule for this module class.

empty_state.notes: variant: empty|blocked|clear|absent; issue #282 'Route .op-absence consumers through StatePanel' shows adoption is still in progress even internally.

kpi_stat_tile.notes: stat tile wrapping NardukLineChart; only 1 consumer measured via tag-grep so reuse is currently low, but it is the app's only KPI-tile-with-sparkline pattern.

keyboard_shortcuts.notes: role="dialog" command palette; not a lane-target pattern, noted for completeness only.

other.notes: role="dialog" evidence drawer, domain-specific overlay, not a generic modal/confirm pattern.

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable
top_extraction_candidates.why: Only table primitive in the app, already fully migrated off ~11 hand-rolled tables (PRs #155/159/186/269/276), a11y-reviewed (real table semantics preserved through responsive reflow), and covered by 647 lines of e2e + a unit test. Best available real-world starting point for a shared narduk-libs table, but ships zero sort/paginate/search -- an extracted version must add those.

top_extraction_candidates.name: StatePanel
top_extraction_candidates.why: 22 consumers, richer than a plain empty state (4 variants: empty/blocked/clear/absent), highest-reuse non-table component found in this repo.

top_extraction_candidates.name: FreshnessStamp
top_extraction_candidates.why: 16 consumers for a 30-line component -- high reuse density; narduk-ui already ships NsFreshnessChip, worth a direct comparison (L0's job) before extracting a second implementation.

notes: Single-app repo (app/ at root, not a monorepo). Architecture is read-model-driven (top-level read-model/ dir, contract.json) -- server/api routes serve pre-aggregated snapshots, not paginated DB queries, so 'server_list_contracts' is genuinely empty here, not unmeasured. The brief's premise of '~11 raw <table> usages' describes this app's PRE-migration state; as of surveyed_sha the count is 1 real table primitive (CollectionTable) with 17 consumers -- this is itself evidence for the estate-wide table extraction (a real app already proved the pattern and paid down the horizontal-scroll/a11y defects a shared component should avoid repeating elsewhere).
